This version encompassed two updates, the initial Release v1.12.0 update (released 28 August 2020, reverted shortly after) and the Hardcore Testing BETA (released same day as Release v1.12.0, 28 August 2020).
This version was also the first time that updates appeared on seperate devforum posts instead of being all in one devforum post.

This update was the first update to start with a live event. There was a purple door with an eye in the lobby that had a timer on it. After the timer hit 00:00:00, the live event would start. It began with the screen going black, with the following text being displayed:
[???]: The end is only the beginning

After this, the screen would return to normal and the skybox in the lobby would change. Purple orbs would then begin to fall from the sky, with your goal being to avoid them for 1 minute and 30 seconds. Regardless of whether you survived or not, an animation would play after 1 minute and 30 seconds, showing spinning purple light being emitted from the eye in the door, and shortly after other parts of the door would turn neon purple. The eye would then turn into a black hole that pulled in multiple parts of the lobby and players. After this the screen would turn black and everyone would be kicked from the server. You received a
for participating in this live event.
